column1: # Finagotchi dual-slot OTA layout for the 8 MB flash (ESP32-S3 N8 / N8R2).
# Replaces huge_app.csv on hardware builds — see OTA.md §2.
# otadata MUST sit at 0xe000: the Arduino/PlatformIO upload always writes
# boot_app0.bin (the "boot ota_0" otadata image) to 0xe000. The previous
# table had nvs spanning 0x9000-0xF000 and otadata at 0x710000
# USB flash overwrote the last two NVS pages (lost Wi-Fi creds / bonds /
# parental code) and never reset otadata (after an OTA
# booting the old ota_1 slot). This is the stock Arduino 8 MB OTA shape.
